name: Excavated Foundation Example
description:
Adds partially buried stone chambers that combine an authored foundation footprint with exact excavation voxels. Copy the complete 03_adv_22_excavated_foundation folder into lua_scripts.

The template marks its interior as terrain_clearance. The Lua declaration excavates those exact transformed cells plus a reusable named entrance mask, while a separate authored two-dimensional mask builds the foundation. Overlap order is deterministic: excavation runs first, foundation writes win next, and the final structure wins over both.
